# I Miss You Memorial

> A place to create a beautiful online memorial page for someone you love — their photos, their story, and the voices of everyone who misses them. A complete tribute page is free, forever. Every tribute stays online; we never charge a family to keep a memory alive.

I Miss You Memorial (imissyoumemorial.com) helps families build and keep memorial tribute pages: photo and note boards, a life story told in chapters, voice and video memories, candles and flowers left by visitors, and family moderation so every word waits for the family before it appears. Pricing is $0 for a complete page · Plus at $197 once, yours for life, for video, voice, and every photo · Concierge, a hand-built tribute, from $499. There is no subscription on any plan.

- [Obituary writer](https://imissyoumemorial.com/tools/obituary-writer/): a guided way to write an obituary, question by question
- [Funeral program maker](https://imissyoumemorial.com/tools/funeral-program-maker/): build and print a program for the service
- [Memorial card maker](https://imissyoumemorial.com/tools/memorial-card-maker/): keepsake cards to hand to those who came

## Templates and guides

- [Obituary templates](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/obituary/): fill-in templates for a mother, father, husband, wife, grandmother, and more
- [Funeral program templates](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/funeral-program/): Word, PDF, bifold, trifold, and order-of-service formats, including Catholic, Baptist, Jewish, and military
- [Eulogy templates](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/eulogy/): a place to start when the words will not come
- [Memorial card templates](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/memorial-cards/): prayer cards, Christian, Jewish yahrzeit, and secular designs
- [Verses for memorial cards](https://imissyoumemorial.com/guides/verses-for-memorial-cards/): scripture, poetry, and plain words that hold up
- [What a funeral costs](https://imissyoumemorial.com/guides/average-funeral-cost/): national averages with state-by-state guides
- [Funeral planning checklist](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/funeral-planning-checklist/): the first days, in order
- [When someone dies: a checklist](https://imissyoumemorial.com/templates/when-someone-dies-checklist/): what must happen, and what can wait

## Notes on remembering

- [What to write on a memorial page, when there are no words](https://imissyoumemorial.com/blog/what-to-write-on-a-memorial-page): gentle, honest phrases for a mother, a father, a partner, a friend
- [When Facebook memorializes an account: what happens next](https://imissyoumemorial.com/blog/facebook-memorialized-account-what-happens): what legacy contacts can and cannot do, and how families keep what matters
- [A guide to QR code memorials: plaques, benches, and headstones](https://imissyoumemorial.com/blog/qr-code-memorial-guide): how the codes work and how to choose a page that outlasts the plaque
- [Alternatives to a Facebook memorial page in 2026](https://imissyoumemorial.com/blog/alternatives-to-a-facebook-memorial-page): what families use instead — memorial websites, shared albums, keepsakes — compared plainly
- [A free memorial website that never deletes pages](https://imissyoumemorial.com/blog/free-memorial-website-that-never-deletes): why online memorials disappear, how free services compare on permanence, and the promise I Miss You Memorial makes in writing

## Promises

- Every tribute stays online. Free stays free, forever.
- If a Plus plan lapses, the page stays; premium features rest. Nothing is ever deleted.
- Families choose who sees a page — public, unlisted, or password-protected — and whether search engines may find it.
